purpose: Diagnostic attribution, not a performance optimization or replacement capacity baseline.
serverSource: Prepared capacity benchmark from 7b21811736298ee53137168b7073926766f3fb8f, same offline-sync core as PR195, plus immutable postgres driver 79560a928c6b9307e89fe52f368f68dfce01eb79.
clientSource: Capacity source 7b218117 plus the client probes later committed as 68fe083f02ab241117bd3616fcde2f08e2e9d173; identical executable to the preceding client-delay-split campaign.
sampling: One user, both alternating writers; ten correlated exercise rounds per trial. No extra SQL, TLS/cancellation/transaction behavior changes, or full-query value logging.
workload: 32 users, 2 devices each, 10 rounds per user, one Person insert per round, eight workers. Established streams; local write to exact peer ORM-watch observation. Startup, warmup, final verify and teardown excluded.

cpuCounterLimit: Thread CPU increments were quantized in 10000us. Fine per-function CPU shares are not inferred. No Cloud native CPU flamegraph or Dart VM CPU/heap sample was collected.
